headline: As of 2026-10-12: 3,322,474 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 34 of 50 states, D+24.6 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 3,322,474 early/mail ballots cast so far across 34 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+24.6 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (519,970), Florida (517,435), Michigan (393,689).
